component-metadata.author: knimeuser
component-metadata.description:
Metanode calculates cumulative statistics individually from the selected columns.
The provided columns are process individually in the following way: 1) each column is sorted from the lowest to the highest values (missing values are kept at the beginning) 2) moving aggregation statistics (e.g., sum) is calculated for individual rows of the sorted column (e.g., there is sum of the first ten rows on the 10. row in case of the cumulative sum is calculated) 3) column is resorted back to the original order 4) common prefix and or suffix is added to the calculated columns 5) suffix is added to the calculated columns based on the cumulative statistics calculated
Statistics possible to calculate are the following: - sum - returns the cumulative sum from the lowest to the higher values - count - returns cumulative count from the lowest to the highest value (i.e., order of values is returned); one can set whether to count also zero values or ignore them (default)
You can return only the calculated columns or add them to the original data matrix.
